book.name: Maliki
book.title: N'halo ghwa maha handa paghutyekwite na MALIKI

content: Yesu kanguyeghwa kwa Pilato
Malabhila putiputi, akaandundame hilongohi, papamu na aghohi, na ahunda bha Malaghilo na aghoyi bha Libalasa lyoha bhakipatana kala malobhe, bhakinmopa Yesu na kunnyegha na kunkamuha kwa Pilato.
Pilato kakinkonya, “Ghwenga ndo Mutwa ghwa Akaayahudi?” Yesu kakinnyanga, “Ena yibha handa ghughombite.”
Hilongohi bha Akandundame bhakinkokela Yesu kwa mihalo miyoloho.
Pilato kakinkonya kangi, “Bhuli, ghubhegha na kya kuyanga ng'obhe? Ghulole nongwa nyoloho bhaghuyegheliti ya kya ghwenga.”
Peni Yesu kakiyanga ng'obhe kyoheli, ndo Pilato kakikangacha.
Pilato kanguntosa Yesu ngati kahweghe
Yikibhegha hitohe yabhe pachekwa ya Pasaka Pilato kunmopolela ywakabheghite mu kibhopo ywohele ywene bhandu bhaanpalite.
Mumasiku agho kakibhegha mundu yumo ywaankemiteghe Balaba ywakabhopitwe papamu na akiluka bhangi, bhakiakoma bhandu mu bhulwa nkulu.
Lula lumati lwa bhandu lukihika kwa Pilato na lukipala kabhatendele handa muyibheghite hitohe hyaki.
Pilato kakiakonya, “Mungupala nibhahughulile ayu Mutwa ghwa Akaayahudi?”
Pilato kakilongela bhula kiyaha kakimanya kukita alongohi ghwa Andundame bhakinnyegha Yesu kwa mwene kwa luhila.
Peni hilongohi bha andundame bhakilukokeha lula lumati lwa bhandu bhannyupe Pilato kabhabhopolele Balaba mbole ya Yesu.
Pilato kakiakonya kangi, “Hinu mungupala nintendele niki ayu yumunkema Mutwa ghwa Akaayahudi?”
Bhakituta kyobho kunu bhakighomba “Ghummangalile palupingika!”
Pilato kakiakonya, “Kiyaha niki? Katenda uhakata niki?” Peni bhene bhakituta kyobho kwa makakala makulu, pabhakighomba, “Ghummangalile!”
Pilato pakipala kulunogheha lula lumati lwa bhandu, kakibhahughulila Balaba, na mbole ya kuntegheka Yesu kututwa hinjupunjupu mbole kakinbhuha kabamandwe.
Amachonda bhangunhwangila Yesu
Amachonda bhakinyegha Yesu mbaka kuludamu lwa nyumbakati lwa kitutubhi kya nkulu ghwa nnima ghwa Yudea, akwo bhakikongana kimati kyoha kya machonda.
Bhakinhwaliha Yesu lipinda lya salabati na kilemba kya ghubhutwa kipyokolitwe kwa mihomi na bhakinhwika mumutwe.
Bhakiyanda kunnjambuha kwa uyuyuho, “Mwika, Mutwa ghwa Akaayahudi.”
Bhakintuta nhimbati ghwa nndenge kumutwe, bhakinhunila mata, bhakichutama mayughwa mukibhungi kyake na bhakinhokamila.
Paayomolite kuntendela lihwangila bhakinhula lila lipinda lya salabati na bhakinhwalia mapinda ghake. Mbole bhakinpiha panje bhakammangalile.
Yesu kangumangalilwa mulupingika.
Mundu yumo kuhuma ku Kilene, lihina lyake Simoni, tate ghwabhe Alekisanda na Lufo, kakibha mumwanja kuhuma panje ya kitami, amachonda bhakinkwilikiha kulughegha lula lupingika lwa Yesu.
Ndo bhakinng'egha Yesu mbaka ku Goligota mana yake, pa Huhu ya Mutwe.
Nabho bhakinpegha bhwengu ghuhanganganikite na ntela ghukemitwe manemane, peni kinywegha ng'obhe.
Ndo bhakimmangalila mulupingika, na bhakighabhana mapinda ghake mumabhwombe kwa kutenda uhaghulo ngati ghani kapati kyoki.
Ndo yikibhegha malabhila ya saa ndatu paamangalite mulupingika.
Bhakityeka malembo gha nongwa yake, “Mutwa ghwa Akaayahudi.”
Papamu na ywombe bhakibhangalilwa apoka abhili, yumoo mumbande yake ya nnilo na yungi mumbande ya ngiya kila mundu mulupingika lwake.
Na matyeko mang'anyimo ghakitengeleheka ghaghombite “Kakibhalangwa papamu na bhanauhokelo.”
Bhandu bha apitite ugheghela na apwo bhakinokola mitwe yabhe kwa lihwangila na bhakinligha paakighomba “Aaah, ghwenga ghwakukikanjaghana Kitutubhi kya Chapanga na kukichenga mumasiku mandatu!
Hino ghulilopohe ghumwene, ghuhuluke mulipingika.”
Ubhwabhu abhu Hilongohi bha andundame papamu na ahunda bha malaghilo bhakintendela lihwangila mubhombe paakighomba, “Ywene kakialopoha bhandu bhangi, peni kahotola ng'obhe kulilopoha mwene!
Maka ayu, Kilisto ywakahaghulitwe na Chapanga, Mutwa ghwa Akaayahudi, kahuluke hinu kuhuma mulipingika, ngati tubhone na kuhyubhalila.” Bhala abhili bhaabhangalitwe papamu naywo nabho bhakinligha.
Yesu kangughwegha palupingika.
Paihikite saa nhano na yimu mbaka saa nhano na nchehe pamuhi kukibhegha na lubhindu lukulu lukighubika nnima ghoha.
Mulisaa lya nhano na ncheche makimuhi Yesu kakilila kwa lilobhe likulu pakilongela “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakitani?” Mana hyaki, “Eeeh Chapanga, Chapanga ghwangu bhuli ghunguneka?”
Bhandu amoo bhangi ayimite paugheghela paayihwite mihalo aywo bhakighomba, “Munnyihwe kangunkema Eliya.”

Mundu yumo kakitugha lubhilo, kaghenda kutola libhoya na kuchwika mu difwai yichachandikite, kakilibhika mulidenge, kakinpegha kanyweghe pakighomba, “Hinu, munleke, ngati tubhone kukita Eliya katahika kunhuluha apwo palupingika.”
Mbole Yesu kakilila kwa lilobhe likulu na kakighwegha.
Na lipasia likulu lya kitutubhi kya Chapanga lukibaluka mbande hibhili kuhumila unani mbaka pahi yake.
Hino yumoo ywa akulu bha amachonda ayimite apwo muulongolo ghwa lupingika ghwa Yesu, pakabhonine pakaghonjite ntumba, kakighomba, “Kulyaghila mundu ayu kakibhegha Mwana ghwa Chapanga!”
Hilahila akibhegha adala ammoo bhangi kya kutali, na mubhene akibhegha, Malia mundu nndala ghwa ku Magidala, Malia ma ywabhe Yakobu nndokwa na Yosefu papamu na Salome.
Adala abha ndo bhantughilite Yesu na kuntangatila paabheghite ku Galilaya. Kangi bhakibhegha adala bhangi ayoloho bhahikite papamu naywo ku Yelusalemu.
Yesu kangubhikwa mu lindogholo
Payihikite makimuhi, kiyaha likibhegha lisiku lya Makunganiko, lisiku limo kukali na kuhika Lisiku lya Kupughwa.
Yosefu ghwa Alimataya mundu ghwa kuhokamilwa mu njenga kaya ngulu ya Akaayahudi, naywo kakighupala muno Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga. Kaking'endela Pilato kya nga lyogha na kakighupala mmili ghwa Yesu.
Pilato kakikangacha pakayihwite kukita Yesu kahwegha kala. Ndo kakinkema yula kilongohi ghwa amachonda, na kakinkonya kukita handa Yesu kahwegha kala.
Pilato pakayihwite nhalo ghwa kuhwegha kwa Yesu kuhuma kwa nkulu ghwa machonda, Pilato kakintegheka Yosefu kakaghutole ntumba aghwo.

Apo Yosefu kakihemela sanda, kakighuhuluha mmili ghwa Yesu kuhuma mulupingika, mbole kakighunyengeleha sanda na kakimmika mulindogholo lihongolitwe mulitalabha na kakilibhilingiha liganga na kulitata lindogholo alyo.
Malia mundu nndala ghwa ku Magidala na Malia ma ghwake Yosefu bhakipabhona apwo pakaghonjihitwe.
